name: Before the Moon Rises
source:
You are being hunted. By townsfolk, a strange beast, and even your own mind.

Confront the mysteries of your past while you search for a way to make it safely through the night in the point-and-click mystery game.

You'll need to keep your wits about you as you hunt for answers.

[From [url=https://laikaslostsignal.itch.io/before-the-moon-rises]Itch.io[/url]]
